verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a self-hosted LLM gateway that stores keys, spend, users and logs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents an export of all user/proxy data in open formats. Logging proxy traffic to S3/GCS/OpenTelemetry is a different feature (ongoing telemetry, not a full data export), and OpenAI-format responses and drop-in provider swapping are about API compatibility, not taking your data with you.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
